summary: r001 was REVISE because one test was self-contradictory: it set both aesthetic override flags to True and asserted they were not True, without invoking the schema validator. Changed the test to mutate both flags and assert Draft 2020-12 validation returns exactly two errors, proving the schema barrier; no design or schema change was needed.
assumptions: The existing review protocol remains the canonical IDEA-level aesthetics artifact, and the schema's const:false constraints are the hard barrier against aesthetic override of hard constraints.
unresolved_risks: This remains context-bound, non-authoritative aesthetics screening; it does not establish structural safety, constructability, or release readiness.
